text:
Maya: heads up — observing token-stream stalls from inference-service in us-west-2 (prod). ~1.2% of streaming sessions show gaps of 250-600ms between tokens. Root cause appears network-level (reordering/jitter) rather than model runtime.
Dan: do we have correlation with recent infra changes? kernel or ToR config?
Maya: we upgraded node kernel to 6.1.15 and landed RDMA kernel hooks for GPUDirect last night in awsu-azb. Also saw ToR MTU bumped to 9216 in the same AZ during maintenance.
Priya: that MTU discrepancy (host 1500 vs ToR 9216) can cause fragmentation/reordering at NIC/driver level. saw dup acks and out-of-order on flows to g-serving pods in tcpdump.
Maya: attaching quick capture snippet i ran on a victim host:
```
# tcpdump -i eth0 -w reorder.pcap 'tcp and host 10.20.30.5'
08:12:01.123456 IP 10.20.30.5.12345 > 10.30.40.6.443: Flags [P], seq 1:141, ack 1, win 64240
08:12:01.124100 IP 10.20.30.5.12345 > 10.30.40.6.443: Flags [P], seq 142:282, ack 1, win 64240  (reordered)
08:12:01.124900 IP 10.20.30.5.12345 > 10.30.40.6.443: Flags [P], seq 283:423, ack 1, win 64240
```
Maya: netstat shows retransmits and high tcp_reordering metric on host.
Dan: can we toggle GRO/GSO for quick mitigation? previous incidents improved after disabling GRO on NICs when reordering was present.
Priya: yes, disabling GRO reduced token gap tail in a staging rack earlier: `ethtool -K eth0 gro off gso off tso off` — but perf cost on CPU.
NetworkBot: note — ToR MTU change executed 03:40 UTC (change 9216), impacted rack awsu-azb-leaf2. Change ticket NET-7821.
Maya: action plan: 1) coordinate immediate mitigation (GRO off on affected hosts) 2) roll one-node kernel rollback for the most impacted cohort 3) request network team to revert MTU or align host MTU 4) add flow-level packet ordering telemetry.
Dan: +1. I'll push GRO toggle as a canary to 3 hosts then measure token gap percent. If effective, widen rollout and open a constrained perf ticket.
Priya: I'll capture additional pcaps and check RDMA/ibverbs counters — GPUDirect path may reorder when NIC coalescing differs.
SREBot: INC-2026-045 created for us-west-2 streaming jitter; severity P2. Assigned: Maya, Dan, Priya, NetworkOps.
Maya: also seeing a small spike in tail RPC cancels (deadline exceeded) tying back to token gaps. If throttles kick in consumers see poor UX. Prioritize.
Dan: noted — I'll schedule a quick sync with NetworkOps in 15m and post runbook steps here. Thanks all :thumbsup:
